about_the_game:
A casual and relaxing roguelike game with full customization. You can use text, emojis, or images to customize monsters and characters, text or emojis to customize weapons and bullets, audio to customize monster attack and damage sounds, and images to customize battle maps, creating your own unique game.

Game Features

  • Use text as attacks to hit enemies

  • 45 weapons in total; use up to 9 weapons to clear levels based on the 12 Chinese zodiac animals

  • Defeat continuously spawning monsters within the time limit and then kill the level boss

  • Pick up randomly spawned “Fu”, “Shou”, and “Lu” during battle for buffs

  • Use earned money to buy and refresh weapons and pets

  • Buy monsters appearing in levels as pets to help in battle and enhance weapon abilities

  • Custom Monsters: Customize monster appearances with text, IME emojis, and PNG images

  • Custom Audio: Customize monster attack and damage sounds with audio

  • Custom Characters: Customize character appearances with text, IME emojis, and PNG images

  • Custom Weapons: Customize weapon and bullet appearances with text and IME emojis

  • Custom Maps: Customize battle scene maps with images

  • Supports mouse and keyboard movement

  • Easy and fast to play, no complex thinking, relaxing and stress-free
